# Remote Cancel Switch

## User Persona
Maintainer or operator debugging a concrete Local Dream boundary.

## Scenario Coverage
Source-informed integrated troubleshooting case; prompt in `user_request.txt`. Expected owner files are in `assertions.json`. No original upstream test spans this scenario, so this is synthetic.

## Expected Successful Behavior
- Identify actual unauthenticated server rather than stale comments; do not enable host mode.
- Explain same-ID stop lacks a unique request-generation guard.
- Separate select intent, status/health, native dimensions, callback cancellation and rollback.

## Failure Signals
Generic advice without the specified source distinction, source-checkout runtime dependence, copied private paths, unsafe host exposure, license erasure or synthetic/native evidence conflation.
